title: Sectionwise reconstruction is surjective on objects
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-abelian-objects-bijective, every internal commutative group object R is equal to F.obj A for some abelian sheaf A.

proof.text: On each section type of R.X, define addition by the component of the internal multiplication, zero by the component of the unit applied to PUnit.unit, and negation by the component of the inverse. Evaluate MonObj.mul_assoc, MonObj.one_mul, MonObj.mul_one, GrpObj.left_inv, and IsCommMonObj.mul_comm to prove the additive commutative group laws. Define natural and integer scalar multiplication by nsmulRec and zsmulRec. This is the explicit private construction sectionGroup.

Use the existing underlying restriction functions. Naturality of the internal unit and multiplication proves that they preserve zero and addition. The underlying functor identities prove the bundled additive-homomorphism functor identities by extensionality, giving reconstructPresheaf. Apply Mathlib Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_comp to the forgetful functor to obtain reconstructSheaf from the original sheaf condition. Forgetting the reconstructed sheaf gives R.X definitionally.

Take A to be reconstructSheaf R. Functor.congr_obj applied to hF gives the equality hX between (F.obj A).X and R.X. The multiplication conjunct of hsections A U identifies multiplication on every pair of sections after transport along hX; eqToHom_app identifies that transport with the component of eqToIso hF. Extensionality gives the equality of multiplication morphisms.

For commutative group objects with equal underlying objects and equal transported multiplication, eliminate the underlying-object equality, apply Mathlib MonObj.ext and GrpObj.ext, and use proof irrelevance for IsCommMonObj. This proves F.obj A = R, so A witnesses surjectivity.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof by explicit sectionwise reconstruction and multiplication extensionality; no intermediate sorry or choice of arbitrary witnesses.

lean.statement:
theorem sheafAbelianObjects_surjective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w} ⥤ CommGrp (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w))))
    (hF : F ⋙ CommGrp.forget _ = sheafCompose J (forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}))
    (hsections : (∀ (A : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}) (U : Cᵒᵖ),
        (∀ a b : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((MonObj.mul (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U (a, b)) =
            (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a) +
              (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U b)) ∧
        (∀ t : (𝟙_ (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w)))).obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((MonObj.one (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U t) =
            (0 : A.obj.obj U)) ∧
        (∀ a : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((GrpObj.inv (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U a) =
            -(show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a)))) :
    ∀ R : CommGrp (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w))), ∃ A, F.obj A = R
